title: Email Waterfall on Your Own Keys
one_line: Run a work email waterfall across your own finder accounts, verify every address it returns, and report the find rate and the cost per verified email.
description: Run a work email waterfall across your own finder accounts, verify every address it returns, and report the find rate and the cost per verified email. Use when someone wants to find work emails without platform credits, compare finder providers, or replace a credit heavy enrichment column.
paragraph: A waterfall tries one finder, then the next, until an address comes back. Run on your own provider keys it costs what the providers charge and nothing more, and the order of providers decides most of the cost. This skill runs a small test to set the order, runs the list, verifies every address, and reports the verified find rate and the cost per verified address, which is the only number that compares fairly across providers.
keywords: find work emails with my own keys
cheaper than clay credits for emails

requirements.cost: A free Apify account works. Each run bills your own Apify account at the actor's Store price: email-waterfall-orchestrator 0.003 USD per contact searched and 0.004 USD per email found; email-verifier 0.0016 USD per email verified.
Free. On a python.org install on macOS, run `Install Certificates.command` once, or the script falls back to the system certificate file and says so if it cannot.

requirements.item: One of: Findymail API key, Prospeo API key or Icypeas API key
requirements.used_for: At least one finder key; the waterfall skips any provider with no key
requirements.cost: Billed by that provider on your own plan. This skill adds no markup.
